title: Top Treadmills for Small Spaces & Home Gyms (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected from Consumer Reports, CNET, and OutdoorGearLab reviews that each mention the product.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no cost comparison is included.

verdict.line: The NordicTrack X24 is ideal for runners who want a versatile machine that connects to apps and supports heart‑rate monitors. It offers a large running surface and iFit integration, making it a good fit for serious training, but it is heavier and noisier than the other picks.
